programs.name: 1RM / Max Testing
programs.description: Baseline block to establish strength 1RMs (squat / hinge / press / pull families), optional run time-trial PRs (100 m → 5 km), and classic benchmark WODs (Fran, Cindy, Murph…). Warm-up ladders and attempt rules only — no hypertrophy accessories. Log results under Maxes → Strength / Running / Benchmarks. Curated / peer-informed — not a competition meet protocol.
programs.audience: Anyone starting a strength block without current 1RMs, re-baselining mid-season, or filling gaps across squat / hinge / press / pull families
programs.coachNotes: Strength days: warm-up ladder (≈40×5 → 60×3 → 75×2 → 85×1 → 92×1 → 97×1 → 100×1). Full 3–5 min rest above 90%. Miss or form break = end that lift. Optional secondary maxes use a shorter ladder — skip if the primary was grinding. Run / benchmark days are optional — pick one primary test per session. Log under Workout → Maxes (Strength · Running · Benchmarks tabs). Every set stays editable after import.

days.name: Day 1 — Squats
days.sessionPad: Establishes: Back Squat 1RM (primary) · Front Squat 1RM (optional secondary). Skip front squat if back-squat top single was a grinder. Warm-up only — no accessory volume.

exercises.notes: Prep hips + T-spine before loading · RPE 7–8 · leave 2–3 reps in reserve
Back squat 1RM — full ladder. Brace hard, controlled eccentric. Spotter / safety pins near top singles. Log to Maxes.
OPTIONAL secondary: front squat 1RM — shorter ladder. Conservative opener. Elbows high. Skip if fatigued.

days.name: Day 2 — Bench + Row
days.sessionPad: Establishes: Bench Press 1RM (primary) · Barbell Row 1RM (optional secondary). Row is antagonistic — take it only if bench left you fresh enough.

exercises.notes: Open T-spine before pressing · RPE 7–8 · leave 2–3 reps in reserve
Bench 1RM — full ladder. Spotter recommended near top singles. Touch-and-press, feet planted. Log to Maxes.
OPTIONAL secondary: barbell bent-over row 1RM — shorter ladder. Strict torso; no bounce. Log best clean single.

days.name: Day 3 — Deadlift
days.sessionPad: Establishes: Conventional Deadlift 1RM only. One heavy hinge today — do not stack trap-bar the same session. Longer rest above 90%.

exercises.notes: Wake up the spine — no load · RPE 7–8 · leave 2–3 reps in reserve
Conventional deadlift 1RM — full ladder. Reset each single (no bounce). Prefer competition stance. Log best clean single to Maxes.

days.name: Day 4 — Strict Press + Pull-Up
days.sessionPad: Establishes: Strict Overhead Press 1RM · Weighted Pull-Up or Chin-Up 1RM. Strict press only (no leg drive). For pull-ups: add belt/DB load once bodyweight singles are easy; log total external load + BW context in notes.

exercises.notes: Light scap + T-spine prep · RPE 7–8 · leave 2–3 reps in reserve
Strict press 1RM (no push-press / no leg drive). Full ladder. Glutes squeezed, lockout tall. Shorter ladder OK if shoulders taxed.

Weighted pull-up 1RM — shorter ladder on added load (or work up in kg on belt/DB). Full hang, chest to bar. If BW AMRAP <5, establish a hard bodyweight single / max-reps baseline instead. Log to Maxes. · Weighted: pick added load (belt / vest) for 1 reps @ target RIR (starts RIR 0).

OPTIONAL alternate grip: weighted chin-up 1RM. Pick pull-up OR chin — not both at true max. Skip if pull-up already emptied you. · Weighted: pick added load (belt / vest) for 1 reps @ target RIR (starts RIR 0).

days.name: Day 5 — Trap Bar + Hip Thrust
days.sessionPad: Establishes: Trap Bar Deadlift 1RM (primary) · Hip Thrust 1RM (optional secondary). Trap bar is a separate family from conventional — useful athletic baseline. Skip if still sore from Day 3.

exercises.notes: Open hips before hinge / thrust · RPE 7–8 · leave 2–3 reps in reserve
Trap-bar deadlift 1RM — full ladder. High or low handles — note which in Maxes notes. Drive floor away; lockout tall.
OPTIONAL secondary: barbell hip thrust 1RM — shorter ladder. Pause at top, posterior tilt. Pad the bar. Skip if trap-bar took everything.

days.name: Day 6 — Bench variants + Clean (optional)
days.sessionPad: Establishes (pick what you need): Incline BB Bench and/or Close-Grip Bench · optional Power Clean. Fully optional day — skip any lift you do not program. Technique quality over absolute load on the clean.

exercises.notes: Light prep — optional day · RPE 7–8 · leave 2–3 reps in reserve
OPTIONAL: incline barbell bench 1RM — shorter ladder. Separate family from flat bench. Spotter recommended.
OPTIONAL: close-grip bench 1RM — shorter ladder. Pick incline OR close-grip as the hard single if both feel fresh; do not redline both.
OPTIONAL: power clean 1RM — shorter ladder. Receive quality over load; a heavy single with a poor catch does not count. Skip if you do not pull from the floor.

days.name: Optional — Run PR
days.sessionPad: Establishes: one running distance PR (pick primary). Do not stack a hard 5k with a true 400 m max the same day. Warm up thoroughly; log time under Maxes → Running.

exercises.notes: Easy mobility before strides · RPE 7–8 · leave 2–3 reps in reserve
Build-up strides only — technique, not a sprint PR · RPE 7–8 · leave 2–3 reps in reserve
OPTIONAL primary: 100 m TT. Full recovery. Log best time → Maxes → Running.
OPTIONAL alternate primary: 400 m. Skip if you already ran 100 m all-out.
OPTIONAL endurance PR: 1 km. Prefer this OR mile/2k/5k — one hard distance effort.
OPTIONAL: 1 mile TT. Log → Maxes → Running.
OPTIONAL: 5 km TT. Fresh legs only — not after another hard PR today.

days.name: Optional — Benchmark WOD
days.sessionPad: Establishes: one classic benchmark (Fran / Cindy / Murph / Helen / DT / Row 2k). Pick a single test — do not redline two WODs. Log under Maxes → Benchmarks.

exercises.notes: Light prep — then one benchmark only · RPE 7–8 · leave 2–3 reps in reserve
OPTIONAL: Fran 21-15-9 thrusters + pull-ups. RX or note scaled loads. Log time → Maxes → Benchmarks.
OPTIONAL alternate: Cindy AMRAP 20. Log rounds+reps → Maxes → Benchmarks.
OPTIONAL: Helen 3 RFT. Skip if Fran/Cindy already done.
OPTIONAL engine: Row 2k TT. Log time → Maxes → Benchmarks.
OPTIONAL hero: Murph. Partitioning OK — note vest / partition in Maxes notes.
OPTIONAL: DT 5 RFT. Barbell cycling quality over ego load.
